newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.

text.p: Turnover fell to 1.814 million denars at Thursday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange from 2.852 million denars on Tuesday as only one company traded, the exchange said.

Alkaloid joint stock company sold 1,870 shares at 970 denars, unchanged from Tuesday's close and below par of 2,424 denars. Traded volume was 2,940 shares at Tuesday's session when only Alkaloid stocks traded.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
